facts: Historical mid-to-late June Tyrrhenian water is typically about 74-77°F.
This entire leg is built around genuine warm-water beach and boat days.

budget.provenance: iceland-ischia-cilento canonical budget allocation for three Ischia nights, four Cilento nights and one Fiumicino buffer, ferries, car, food and activities

days.heading: Arrive Forio, Ischia
days.daycost: Est. $220-$360 · train, hydrofoil, transfer and meals
days.note: Settle on Ischia's west coast and make the first swim the proof that the second leg is fundamentally different from Iceland.
days.travelNote: Reserve the hydrofoil only after the 2027 flight day is locked.

spots.name: Forio sunset coast
spots.cost: Beach free; budget for Naples rail, hydrofoil and island transfer.
spots.climate: Tyrrhenian sea historically about 74-77°F in mid-to-late June.

days.heading: Castello Aragonese + Ischia Ponte swim

facts.label: Afternoon
facts.valueHtml: Beach and swim at Ischia Ponte

days.note: Do the stone climb before the heat, then move directly to the water.

spots.name: Castello Aragonese
spots.cost: Recheck 2027 admission; beach access is free.
spots.climate: Warm afternoons make the post-castle swim the correct pacing.

days.heading: San Montano Bay + Negombo
days.note: This is the non-negotiable warm-water day: calm bay first, thermal pools second.

spots.name: San Montano and Negombo

images.alt: Negombo thermal pool opening toward the sea

spots.cost: 2026 signal: €100 for two adults plus child pricing by height; recheck 2027.
spots.climate: Warm sheltered sea plus managed thermal water.

days.heading: Cilento beaches + Punta Licosa
days.note: Move from Ischia by hydrofoil, collect the car, and protect multiple low-logistics swim days around Castellabate.
days.travelNote: Keep the car on the mainland; do not take it to Ischia.

spots.name: Punta Licosa
spots.cost: Beaches free; budget for parking, umbrella and lunch.
spots.climate: Historically warm enough for long family swims by this point in June.

days.heading: Paestum temples + beach
days.feel: Ancient Greece before lunch, warm sea after
days.note: Use the coolest morning hours for the temples and preserve the afternoon as a real swim day.

spots.name: Paestum

images.alt: Paestum temple framed by umbrella pines
images.credit: Magna Graecia Paestum · Google Images source

spots.cost: 2026 signal: €15 adult and under 18 free; recheck 2027.
spots.climate: Little midday shade at the ruins; swim after lunch.

days.heading: Capo Palinuro sea caves + cove swim

facts.label: Payoff
facts.valueHtml: Caves, cliffs and warm-water swim stop

days.note: Book the local boat only when the marine forecast is favorable; otherwise repeat the easy Castellabate beach day.

spots.name: Capo Palinuro

images.alt: Capo Palinuro's limestone cliffs above blue water

spots.cost: 2027 operator price not yet published; hold a family boat-day allowance.
spots.climate: Warm water, but caves are a wind-and-swell decision.

days.heading: Drive to Fiumicino buffer night
days.daycost: Est. $220-$340 · fuel, tolls, lodging and meals

facts.label: Reason
facts.valueHtml: Sleep beside FCO before the transatlantic flight

facts.label: Rule
facts.valueHtml: Do not attempt a dawn Cilento-to-FCO run

days.note: Return the car, eat near the airport, and protect the flight home.
days.travelNote: The buffer night is part of the route, not optional padding.
